purpose: Recover the complete registered P2I evaluation using a common precision-aware solid-side reference rule; no new model training or checkpoint selection.
diagnostic_findings: 17 of 2052 T1 wall/extrema queries fail at 1e-8 and none at 2e-8; all failures water ellipse, unchanged by 512 candidate search or original input coordinates. Quadratic boundary/analytic curve deviations reach 1.5584e-8 normalized. Input mesh coordinates round exactly to float32 export; geometric discrepancy, not proven solver error.
common_rule: max(1e-8, 4*max_sampled_boundary_gap, 4*coordinate_epsilon*max_abs_normalized_coordinate); 33 equally spaced samples per quadratic hole edge; coordinate epsilon is float32 for T1 meshing/export and float64 for exact S1 generator
coordinates: Use exact input coordinates after complete node/element connectivity check for T1; use original exact generated S1 coordinates. No node projection, reference displacement alteration, point removal or extrapolation. PINNs remain evaluated at the original analytic wall coordinates; solid-side FEM offset is an approximation checked independently below.
checks: Original stress reconstruction <0.02%, positive weights, area difference <1e-5 and coordinate inverse checks unchanged. All points must locate with original natural-coordinate tolerance 1e-7. Evaluate FEM wall/extrema at delta/2, delta and 2delta; max absolute displacement changes from delta must both be <1e-5. Both references must pass before any method prediction/ranking. No offset search after this registration.
evaluation: All 24 original P2I endpoints, both sampling arms, all methods, original physics seeds/metrics/targets/costs, plus all wall offset raw arrays; original protocol unchanged except this documented reference implementation.
stop: Failure stops dependent evaluation; no ranking-based revision. Freeze diagnostic and evaluation records in P2J, leave P2I suspension and all training immutable.
